name: Basketball Custom BPM 2.0-style — game-level team adjustment, regular season only
summary: Regular season only (G League includes Showcase Cup). Game-level team adjustment (BPM 2.0 style).
scope: 11 leagues (NBA, NBA G League, EuroLeague, Spain ACB, Turkey BSL, Italy LBA, France LNB, Israel Winner League, Germany BBL, Puerto Rico BSN, CEBL), seasons 2020–21 through 2025–26. Summer leagues (BSN, CEBL) use the original site's labels: summer Y = "YY-(YY+1)".

regular_season_rules.NBA: ESPN season type 2 between the 30 NBA teams; play-in, playoffs, preseason, All-Star games and the NBA Cup final excluded (Cup group, quarterfinal and semifinal games count, as in official standings).
regular_season_rules.NBA G League: ESPN season types 2 (regular season) and 5 (Showcase Cup / Tip-Off Tournament); playoffs and preseason excluded.
regular_season_rules.EuroLeague: Official api-live.euroleague.net games with phaseType RS; play-in, playoffs and Final Four excluded.
regular_season_rules.Spain ACB, Turkey BSL, France LNB, Italy: Basketball-Reference international schedule table "regular-season-games"; playoffs, playouts and cups excluded.
regular_season_rules.Germany BBL, Puerto Rico BSN: SofaScore events whose tournament is exactly the league (not ", Playoffs" / ", Play-in") and without a cup round.
regular_season_rules.CEBL: Genius Sports hosted schedule phase "Regular Season"; box scores from FIBA LiveStats.

professional_box_scores: Every player and team total is summed from regular-season game box scores (per-player minutes and full box stats). Games with an incomplete box (a side with < 150 recorded player minutes) are dropped from both teams and listed in /api/quality.json.
possessions: No league in this build publishes game possessions in the fetched feeds, so every game uses the Basketball-Reference estimate from the two box scores: 0.5 × [(FGA + 0.4·FTA − 1.07·ORB/(ORB+oppDRB)·(FGA−FGM) + TOV) + the same for the opponent]. Team possessions = sum over games. The original site's exact estimator (bpm2-recalculate.mjs) is not public; raw BPM can therefore differ slightly from the original even for identical totals.
minutes_source: ESPN reports whole minutes per game (NBA, G League); EuroLeague, Basketball-Reference, SofaScore and FIBA LiveStats report seconds.
raw_bpm: Season-level BPM 2.0-style box-score regression: per-100 possession contributions from adjusted points, threes, assists, turnovers, offensive/defensive rebounds, steals, blocks, personal fouls, field-goal attempts, and free-throw attempts; coefficients vary with inferred position and offensive role.
position_role: Position and offensive role inferred from box-score shares, shrunk by a neutral 50-minute prior and centered to a team-minute-weighted mean of 3. Listed positions and play-by-play are unavailable for many leagues; results are an approximation, not official Basketball-Reference BPM.
minutes_term: No explicit minutes-per-game bonus or GP+4 penalty in Raw BPM. Minutes determine estimated player possession exposure, position/role prior weighting, and team adjustment weighting.

exact_site_formula.scoring_baseline: 1.0 point per adjusted shot attempt is an explicit site assumption.
exact_site_formula.centering: Position and role are each shifted and clipped to [1,5] until the team-minute-weighted mean is 3.
exact_site_formula.variables: x=(Position-1)/4; y=(Role-1)/4; each stat below is a season total.

team_rating: 100 * (Team points - Opponent points) / estimated possessions, except supported NCAA conference records, which use the supplied Sports Reference adjusted net rating (adjusted offensive rating minus adjusted defensive rating).
no_minutes: Real player-seasons with zero recorded minutes are retained for identity and coverage but have null raw, adjustment, and final BPM. They are not evidence of average (0) performance.
incomplete_inputs: Explicitly reviewed incomplete source inputs also have is_unrated=true and null BPM values even when minutes are positive. These players remain in search and exports but cannot contribute to a rotation in any mode.
team_adjustment_season_constant: SeasonAdj_T = [TeamRating − sum(MinShare*RawBPM)] / sum(MinShare); MinShare = 5*PlayerMinutes/TeamPlayerMinutes (the original site's 2.7 constant, here on regular-season inputs).
team_adjustment: Game-level (BPM 2.0 style). margin_g = 100*(team pts − opp pts)/game possessions; teamAvg_T = mean margin over T's games; gameRating_g = margin_g + teamAvg_(opponent); seasonRating_T = mean gameRating over T's games; context_p = sum_g(gameRating_g*min_pg)/sum_g(min_pg) over the games the player played; TeamAdj_p = SeasonAdj_T + (context_p − seasonRating_T)/5. Players on several teams: per stint, then minute-averaged. Players who played every game move about ±0.1 versus the season constant.
fallback: If a team-season had no game logs the 2.7 season constant would be used and the rows flagged; in this build every team-season has game logs, so no rows use the fallback.
identity: Rows keep the original site's id, player_key, canonical_player_key, url and record_id when the player matches an original row of the same league and season (normalized name, then fuzzy name + minutes). Unmatched rows use a namespaced source id (espn:, euroleague:, bbref:, sofascore:, genius:).
extra_csv_columns: original_site_bpm = the original site's published BPM for the same id; bpm_season_level = this site's raw BPM + 2.7 season constant; team_games, gp_share = player GP / team games.
comparison_modes: The page's "Original-site BPM" and "Original-site schedule-scaled BPM" modes show the original site's published values for the same ids (GET-only copies).
quality_note: Adapts published BPM 2.0 coefficients to regular-season totals with a game-level team adjustment; it is not official Basketball-Reference BPM. Build and coverage checks are published at /api/quality.json.
